tools.name: Lovable
tools.tagline: AI full-stack web app builder for shipping production React and Supabase apps from natural language
tools.description: Lovable turns natural language prompts into full-stack web applications with built-in cloud hosting, databases, code export, and unlimited workspace collaborators sharing a credit pool.

pricingTiers.name: Free
highlights: 5 daily build credits resetting at 00:00 UTC
Public projects hosted on a lovable.app subdomain
20 monthly Cloud credits & unlimited collaborators

pricingTiers.name: Pro
highlights: 100 to 10,000 monthly general credits via tier selector
Private projects, custom domains & full code export
2-month credit rollover, top-ups & branding removal

pricingTiers.name: Business
highlights: Single Sign-On (SSO) & dedicated security center
Default opt-out from AI model training
Exclusive design templates & workspace controls

pricingTiers.name: Enterprise
highlights: SCIM provisioning & audit logs
Data residency & EU inference options
Dedicated Customer Success Manager

keyFeatures: Prompt-to-full-stack React and cloud backend generation
Lovable Cloud built-in hosting, database, and AI feature credits
No per-seat fee with unlimited workspace collaborators
Code editing access, GitHub sync, and full code export
11 scalable monthly credit tiers from 100 to 10,000 credits
pros: Fast prompt-to-live-app prototyping with clean UI defaults
All plans support unlimited workspace members sharing one credit pool
Paid Pro credits roll over for up to two months while active
cons: Complex debugging loops can burn through monthly credits quickly
Free tier is limited to 5 daily credits on public projects
Large generated codebases eventually require manual developer refactoring
tools.bestFor: Founders, product builders, and teams shipping full-stack web apps and MVPs rapidly from prompts

tools.name: Manus
tools.tagline: Autonomous cloud AI agent for multi-step web research, coding, and workflow execution
tools.description: Manus executes complex, multi-step tasks autonomously in a cloud environment—spanning deep web research, data analysis, slide generation, and website deployment—under a credit-based subscription.

pricingTiers.name: Free
highlights: Manus Lite powered Agent Mode
1 concurrent task & up to 2 scheduled automations
Basic chat and lightweight agent workflows

pricingTiers.name: Pro
highlights: Full Manus standard/Max autonomous agent execution
Up to 20 concurrent tasks & 20 scheduled automations
Deep web research, website deployment & slide generation

pricingTiers.name: Extended Pro
highlights: High-volume monthly agent credit pools
Cloud Computer environment on higher tiers
Early beta access & priority support

pricingTiers.name: Team
highlights: Shared team credit pool & add-on packs
Admin controls, usage analytics & training opt-out
SSO and shared slide/asset templates

keyFeatures: Autonomous multi-step browser, research, and code execution
Up to 20 concurrent tasks and 20 scheduled automations on Pro
Automated website deployment, structured data, and slide creation
Pooled team credits with admin analytics and SSO
Daily-refresh free credits to test Manus Lite agent workflows
pros: Handles long-horizon multi-step research and execution autonomously
Generous 300 daily-refresh free credits for lightweight testing
Supports concurrent tasks and recurring scheduled automations
cons: No upfront per-prompt credit cost estimate before running complex loops
Monthly plan credits expire at renewal without rollover
Cloud sandbox execution can stall on heavily gated or complex sites
tools.bestFor: Analysts, operators, and builders delegating autonomous multi-step web research and deliverables

tools.name: Anytype
tools.tagline: Local-first, end-to-end encrypted open-source workspace and knowledge base
tools.description: Anytype combines Notion-style relational objects and wikis with local-first storage, peer-to-peer device sync, and zero-knowledge end-to-end encryption.

pricingTiers.name: Free
pricingTiers.billingNote: Unlimited local storage + 100 MB remote backup
highlights: Local-first zero-knowledge E2EE spaces & P2P sync
Unlimited private spaces & 10 shared channels
Open-source apps on macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS & Android

pricingTiers.name: Plus
pricingTiers.billingNote: Billed annually ($5/mo monthly); 1 GB remote storage
highlights: 1 GB encrypted remote cloud backup
Unlimited shared channels
Custom ANY ID handle (9+ symbols)

pricingTiers.name: Pro
pricingTiers.billingNote: Billed annually ($10/mo monthly); 10 GB remote storage
highlights: 10 GB encrypted remote cloud backup
Shorter custom ANY ID handle (7+ symbols)
Ultra tier available at $16/mo annual for 100 GB

pricingTiers.name: Business
highlights: Admin panels & Single Sign-On (SSO)
Self-hosted coordinator and sync node option
Organization governance with E2EE privacy

keyFeatures: Zero-knowledge end-to-end encryption with local-first data ownership
Peer-to-peer direct device sync plus optional encrypted cloud backup
Typed objects, relations, sets, and graph views for knowledge management
Open-source codebase with self-hosting support for teams
Native offline desktop and mobile apps across all major OSes
pros: True offline local-first ownership with zero-knowledge E2EE
Unlimited local usage on the free tier with P2P sync
Open-source and self-hostable for privacy-strict teams
cons: Object-and-relation mental model has a steeper learning curve than Notion
Real-time multi-user collaboration is less mature than cloud-native suites
Free remote cloud backup is capped at 100 MB
tools.bestFor: Privacy-conscious knowledge workers, researchers, and teams wanting an offline-first Notion alternative
